alana-sales: Artemis Systems procurement asked for a short perf sanity check before contract signature. Goal: validate thin-client single-turn at 300 qps sustained, target p95 < 180ms, p99 < 350ms. Need runbook and a hosted vs dedicated cost delta for the sales deck by EOD.
mike-eng: Got it. Clarify model (quantized vs float), avg prompt+generation tokens, region, and whether we should include cold-cache (KV disabled) path.
zhou-ml: We recommend redwood/v2-small-q4 as the primary quantized candidate and v2-medium (q4) for headroom comparison. They typically send ~30 tokens in and expect ~40 tokens out. Include warm-cache and cold-cache runs, plus a 45s microburst at 900 qps to test shedding/fallback.
alana-sales: Region is us-east-2. They explicitly asked about the ability to failover to a cheaper model during spikes and about log retention for troubleshooting.
priya-ops: Proposed run plan: 1) 2m warmup @ 30 qps, 2) 2m linear ramp to 300 qps, 3) sustain 8m at 300 qps, 4) 45s microburst @ 900 qps, 5) cool down 2m. We'll collect p50/p90/p95/p99, batch size distribution, queueing rates, and error/retry counts.
priya-ops: k6 command I'll start with:
```bash
k6 run --vus 300 --duration 14m --out json=artemis_run.json k6_artemis_thin.js
```
mike-eng: Server config suggestion: 3xT4s with batching window 20-25ms, KV cache on, max_batch_tokens 768. With that config we expect p95 ~140-170ms for v2-small-q4 at sustained 300 qps. Run one v2-medium-q4 to show headroom and one disabled-KV run to show worst-case.
zhou-ml: Also capture per-token timing: batch wait, kernel op, serialization, and any RPC overhead. I'll add model-eval traces for a 1-minute sample.
raul-se: Security note for the customer doc: "Smoke runs redact payloads; logs retain RequestID, model_version, timestamp, worker_id, and region. For Private deployments we can enable customer KMS key residency and streaming audit exports to their SIEM under contract." Use that exact phrasing.
alana-sales: Cost ask: quick back-of-envelope for a 1-hour dedicated run (3xT4 reserved) vs hosted token burn for same traffic and a 15-minute POC run estimate.
priya-ops: Quick math: 300 qps * 40 tokens * 3600s = 43.2M tokens/hr. Hosted list (quantized) ~ $0.07 per 1M -> ~ $3.02/hr in token compute (approx). Dedicated amortized (3xT4) ~ $14-18/hr; runtime+network overhead -> ~$20/hr. 15m POC hosted token cost ~ $0.75; dedicated infra for 15m amortized negligible per-hour but we charge setup ~ $10 if provisioning reserved nodes.
mike-eng: I'll kick off the runs and attach run.json, batch histograms, and a 1-page summary with key numbers and suggested fallbacks by 20:00 ET.
raul-se: Note: Artemis also asked about HSM-backed keys and SSO. For smoke: no HSM needed. SSO integrations require longer lead time and scoping; mention in the deck.

alana-sales: Great, thanks. I'll tell Artemis we have a short run scheduled and will follow up with the security blurb, results, and costs. :thumbsup:
